clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne studies beneath the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. The novice acolyte serves in the Temple Gardens.

Sister Aquinne studies with the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. She is stationed in the Temple Gardens, beneath the Temple of the Moon, learning from the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest needed help, Aquinne sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.
